construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict synthetic object: query, products, preferences, research, knowledge_base, question, limits. Product and source IDs are unique; source links reference catalog products.
shared_schema.offsets: Zero-based, end-exclusive Unicode character offsets into original source text
shared_schema.validation: Shared input and stage validation enforces bounds, finite numbers, stage order, exact citations, parent product identity, exclusions and extractive text.
shared_schema.output: One JSON object with status, synthetic, schema_version, stages and answer. Top-level ok means successful execution, not necessarily an answer. FAQ explicitly abstains without adequate evidence.
shared_schema.errors: File, JSON, schema and validation errors yield one JSON status:error object and exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Only validated search candidates may be ranked. Explicit product/tag exclusions and budget are hard constraints.
Only validated recommended products are researched. Recommendation order affects retrieval score; each finding references its recommendation.
Only products with validated research findings are eligible. Research passage terms influence KB ranking; FAQ records reference findings and cite KB text.

behavior.search: Unicode normalization, case folding, stopword removal, small synonym vocabulary, general catalog token retrieval and bounded typo matching. Positive matches only; deterministic ties.
behavior.interests: Search relevance plus explicit preferred tag/category boosts. Exclusions and maximum price enforced before ranking. Explanations name only observed attributes and scores.
behavior.normal: Sentence passage retrieval by query/question and preference overlap, with recommendation-rank contribution. Findings are exact extracts with source offsets.
behavior.faq: Extractive KB answers require at least 60 percent question-token coverage and upstream research. No research-only answers; unsupported questions abstain explicitly.
behavior.empty_results: Empty output propagates downstream without fallback to unrelated products.
behavior.synthetic_data: Example catalog, prices, research and KB are entirely synthetic.

excluded: LLM callable (not needed by deterministic implementation)
scope.limitations: Lexical overlap is a reference heuristic, not proof that a passage entails a question's answer. Synonyms are a small extensible English vocabulary. Conflicting KB passages may both be returned; extracts preserve qualifiers and negation. Limits can remove otherwise eligible candidates.

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object, status ok, all four stages ok, grounded negative waterproof answer.
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing file subprocess exits 2 with JSON error; malformed JSON, duplicate keys, nonfinite constants and invalid schemas also verified.
test_outcomes.deliverable_check: Exactly the four requested files; no cache or scratch artifacts.
